profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record sits along Edison Drive in Alpharetta, in the northern part of Fulton County, Georgia, tagged as a data center under the descriptive name Secure Data Center. Alpharetta and the surrounding north Fulton corridor do host real technology and corporate office infrastructure, including data handling operations for national companies headquartered in the area, so a small facility of this kind in the vicinity is plausible. However, Secure Data Center reads as a generic functional label rather than a distinctive company brand, the kind of name a mapping contributor might apply to describe a building's apparent purpose rather than transcribe an actual registered business name. The most direct lead, the matching securedatacenter dot com domain, is not a live company site. Its registration has lapsed and the domain now shows only a parking page from its registrar, with no cached content tying it to this Alpharetta address or to any specific operator. No business filing, press coverage, or other operator website could be matched to this location. Given the generic naming and the absence of any confirmable business behind it, this entry is published as an honest account of what could be established, rather than as a verified profile of a named company, and will be revisited if a confirmed operator surfaces.
profile.research_note: No street address in OSM tags beyond Fulton County; reverse geocode places coordinates on Edison Drive, Alpharetta GA 30005, north Fulton, not downtown Atlanta. securedatacenter.com domain registration has expired (Namecheap parking page explicitly states registration expired). No other operator lead found. Generic descriptive name, cannot confirm a real operator behind this tag.

reading.body:
This facility cannot be assessed. The entry in OpenStreetMap is tagged as a data center but carries only a generic descriptive name, "Secure Data Center," rather than a company brand. No operator website or business registration could be confirmed, and no published specifications for power capacity, cooling, or connectivity exist in this site's database. The reverse geocode at the stored coordinates returns only a street address in Alpharetta with no matching business name.

Without published megawatt capacity or technical specifications, this facility does not appear in this site's ranking of Georgia data centers by power. Georgia has 33 mapped facilities tagged as data centers, but only four have published power figures totaling 66.3 MW. This entry may represent a genuine small colocation operation in Atlanta's established carrier market, or it may reflect an OpenStreetMap contributor's generic label for a building's security and IT function rather than a registered facility.

No reading is possible until operator specifications are published or identity is confirmed. Researchers with access to Georgia business registration databases or local real-estate records might resolve whether a distinct operator occupies this location, but this site cannot make that determination from public sources currently available.
